content.comment_body: Hello, I'm attempting to set up a looping system using timers, but it isn't functioning as expected. The first timer should run for 40 seconds, and the second timer should begin after the first stops, also running for 40 seconds. When the second timer finishes, the cycle should restart with the first timer. Is it possible to achieve this using [product_name]?

If you want to alternate two outputs on and off every 40 seconds, you should use an asynchronous pulse generator connected to two outputs, with one routed through a NOT gate. This setup will provide the alternating control you're looking for.

analysis.insight_summary: A user had trouble configuring alternating timer loops, aiming for two outputs to operate one after the other for 40 seconds each. Another user explained that using a pulse generator with a NOT gate addresses the timing logic, clarifying how [product_name] can be applied in this situation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects [product_name] to support easy configuration of a looping alternating timer system and seeks straightforward timing control features.
